image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, positioned on sandy ground. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace covered in patches of green algae or moss. Its head is extended, showing dark skin with distinct yellow linear markings on the neck and face. One front limb is visible, planted firmly in the sand, showing webbed toes and claws. The background is a soft-focus blur of sand and earth tones.

The tail is located at the posterior end of the turtle and is completely occluded by the carapace and the angle of the photograph.
